steps.content: The flooded passages wind like a labyrinth, but you don't need to recall which room is his. Some dark intuition guides you, pulling you toward the only destination.
Finally, you stop at that door.
Ragnar is in the doorway. Once, he may have been a reliable member of the expedition. But after the being in the Abyss drove him mad, none of that matters anymore.
The man you see now is nothing more than an empty, pathetic shell, a trap meant to drag everyone down into the Abyss.
The door isn't locked. You push it open.
The attack you braced for never comes. In fact, the room is exactly as you saw it last time.
No monsters, no strange black ichor. Only a hunched figure sitting by the iron cot, his back turned to you.
How deceptive. His body no longer shows any sign of mutation. You may even mistake him for any other harmless patient.

Why didn't you see it sooner...? Humans are fragile. A little fear, a little pressure... that's all it takes to crush them, turning them into puppets of the Abyss. But that same fragility became the disguise that fooled everyone, making you overlook the one threat you should never have ignored.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hehe... Hehehe...
Ragnar notices you and slowly turns around. His eyes are two pitch-black voids. His mouth is split into an uncanny grin as a dry, raspy laugh escapes from his throat.
It's laughing at you. Mocking you from the husk of your former teammate. Mocking the blind, weak fool you are...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Too late... It's too late... I told you... the monster never died... they're everywhere... everyone is a monster!

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Go. Bring Ragnar and the collectors back to them.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Go back... to them.
Countless images flash through your mind: your encounter with Pylgia in the Abyss, the tragedies aboard the research vessel, Vikmar's disappearance, Sigmund's death...
These memories fill you with overwhelming regret and anger. And that anger catches flame, turning into an unquenchable thirst to kill.
You grab the emergency chisel propped against the door. Your body, overtaken by fury, takes one step forward, then another.
And still, he holds that eerie posture, his hollow, lightless eyes boring into yours, his mouth agape in silent derision.
You can almost hear him saying...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: You can't do it, can you?
No. You'll show him. You'll prove him wrong. You raise the chisel high over your head. Soon, you'll sever the root of this tragedy...
Stop!
Just as you are about to strike, you hear an urgent shout from behind. Soft arms wrap around you, holding you fast and stopping you from landing the final blow.
In an instant, your body freezes, as if plunged into an icy ocean.
But how could you let something so weak stop you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He's the source of contamination on the ship! He's the one who killed Vikmar and Sigmund!!
You're the only one who saw through his disguise. You're righteous. You're good. You must save everyone...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He brought the monsters from the Abyss onto the ship! He led the thing from the water back here!!
Think of those who died. They died because you're foolish, because you're weak! If only you had killed him sooner... if only...
Do you still remember their eyes? Do you remember how they looked at you before they died? You must not forget...
I BELIEVE IN YOU...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I believe... I will not forget... I believe in myself...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will...
TEAR HIM APART TEAR HIM APART TEAR HIM APART TEAR HIM APART TEAR HIM APART TEAR HIM APART...
Once, twice, three times... The thick, sweet tang of blood fills your nostrils.
Blood sprays into the air. The droplets hang there, morphing into countless faces, crying, screaming, sprouting infinite hands that pull you into their embrace.
You're face-to-face with them. They open wide their pitch-black eyes, open their crimson mouths...
For us. For us. Save me. Save me. SAVE ME SAVE ME SAVE ME...
You are doing the right thing... YOU are all doing the right thing.
KILL HIM. KILL HIM. KILL HIM.
You strike again. This time, something splashes onto your lips. A soft, sweet, juicy morsel. It tastes divine.
[Gray Background with White Text]
Your desire is finally sated.
[Back to Normal]
You collapse to the ground, completely drained. You're caught by the person who first tried to stop you.
She holds you in her arms, human warmth seeping through the damp fabric into your body once more. You feel at peace.
...No, it's the warmth of blood.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Shin...?

You jolt upright, only to find her a mangled mess of flesh and blood. You want to grasp the hand that's holding you, but you don't dare, for you can see white bone showing through the gashes on her arm.
They're all stab wounds, your marks left on her with your chisel.
The metallic smell of blood, so comforting moments ago, now makes you want to throw up.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: It's okay... We're here, it's okay...
Impervious to the pain, she gently lifts that hand and rests it against your cheek.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: You just... lost control. You didn't mean it. I know.

Your companions have gathered around, shouting something, but the words barely register. You stare blankly as they scramble to bandage Shin's wounds. You reach out your hands, trying to help... but you realize they're the hands that attacked her.
You come back to your senses, fumbling for a piece of gauze, anything to pass along, but Shin takes your hand first, her fingers cold from the loss of blood.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: I'm glad... I could do something for you...
